items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: this quote unquote young lions craze started to happen with Roy Hargrove and Antonio Hart and all of us came on the scene together

ctx.x: When you came to get a chance to do your own record and you sit down and you say now this is important, what’s going to go on this? So you kind of balanced your own originals with some classic standards?

Well you know I purposely tried to wait as long as I possibly — I tried to pick the time where I said okay well the time is right now. Because I actually had a chance to do my first record maybe six years ago when this quote unquote young lions craze started to happen with Roy Hargrove and Antonio Hart and all of us came on the scene together. And as you well know, record companies started making it a hot commodity. So they were just handing out record contracts just because guys were under 21. And I didn’t want…
That’s a great attitude I think. Who were some of the horn players that caught your ear when you got into jazz?
